# 1) Read in File ====
This section of the code reads in the file and makes the function that makes the plots.
```{r}
#Set plot directories
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggnewscale)

#Set results file
results_file="C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/RSparsePro_Robustness_Testing/combined_results.tsv"
#Read in the results file
input_df <- read.csv(results_file, sep="\t")

#Split locus name up by simulation parameters
input_df <- input_df %>% dplyr::mutate(population=str_sub(locus, start=1, end=3))

```
# 2) Create Power vs Coverage Plotting Function ====
```{r}
create_power_coverage_plot <- function(data, point_size = 3, add_smooth = FALSE) {

  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "locus", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "num_credible_sets", "coverage", "power", "ld_mismatch_degree")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert LD mismatch degree to numeric traits
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      num_traits = suppressWarnings(case_when(
        ld_mismatch_degree == "unmodified" ~ Inf,
        .default = parse_number(str_replace(as.character(ld_mismatch_degree), "_traits", ""))
      )),
      # Create ordered factor for plotting
      ld_numeric = factor(num_traits, 
                         levels = c(50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, Inf),
                         labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "∞")),
      factor_num_causal_variants = as.factor(num_causal_variants)
    )
  
  # Aggregate data with weights
  plot_data <- processed_data %>%
    group_by(population, ld_numeric, num_traits, factor_num_causal_variants) %>%
    summarise(
      weighted_coverage = weighted.mean(coverage, w = num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE),
      weighted_power = weighted.mean(power, w = num_causal_variants, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Generate population-specific color palettes
  n_ld <- length(unique(plot_data$ld_numeric))
  
  eur_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[1:9])(n_ld)
  afr_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[1:9])(n_ld)
  
  # Combine colors with infinite value (black)
  color_values <- c(
    setNames(eur_colors[1:length(eur_colors)-1], paste0("EUR_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    setNames(afr_colors[1:length(afr_colors)-1], paste0("AFR_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    "EUR_∞" = eur_colors[length(eur_colors)],  # Darkest blue
    "AFR_∞" = afr_colors[length(afr_colors)]   # Darkest red
  )
  
  # Create combined population-LD factor
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(pop_ld = factor(paste0(population, "_", ld_numeric)))
  
  # Create base plot
  main_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = weighted_coverage, y = weighted_power,
                             fill = pop_ld)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.8, shape=21, color="black") +
    facet_grid(population ~ factor_num_causal_variants) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.7, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      values = color_values,
      labels = rep(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), 2)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Coverage",
      y = "Power",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size=12),
      axis.title = element_text(size=14),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top"))
  
  # Create legend grid data
  legend_data <- expand.grid(
    population = c("EUR", "AFR"),
    ld_numeric = levels(processed_data$ld_numeric),
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  ) %>% dplyr::arrange(population, ld_numeric) %>% dplyr::mutate(unique_name=paste(population, ld_numeric, sep="_"))
  
  # Create legend plot
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = ld_numeric, y = population)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = unique_name), color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = levels(legend_data$ld_numeric), labels = c(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric)[1:length(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric))-1], "Unmodified")) +
    labs(x = "Degree of LD Mismatch (Number of Traits)", y = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = c("#08306B", "#67000D")),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size=10)
    )
  
  # Combine plots
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    main_plot,
    legend_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(4, 1)
  )
}


```
# 3) Call Power vs. Coverage Plotting Function ====
```{r}
create_power_coverage_plot(input_df)
```
# 4) Create Credible Set Size Plotting Function ====
```{r}
create_faceted_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {
  # Load required packages
  if (!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required")
  if (!require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required")
  if (!require(ggh4x, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggh4x' is required")
  
  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "ld_mismatch_degree", "num_credible_sets")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Process data
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      ld_mismatch_degree = factor(
        ld_mismatch_degree,
        levels = c("50_traits", "100_traits", "200_traits", "300_traits",
                   "400_traits", "500_traits", "1000_traits", "unmodified"),
        labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "∞")
      ),
      population = factor(population, levels = c("EUR", "AFR")),
      num_causal_variants = factor(num_causal_variants)
    ) %>%
    group_by(population, num_causal_variants, ld_mismatch_degree) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_credible_sets = mean(num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_credible_sets = sd(num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(processed_data, 
              aes(x = ld_mismatch_degree, y = mean_credible_sets, fill = population)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = bar_width), 
             color = "black", width = bar_width) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_credible_sets - se_credible_sets,
                      ymax = mean_credible_sets + se_credible_sets),
                  position = position_dodge(width = bar_width), 
                  width = 0.2, color = "black") +
    facet_grid(population ~ num_causal_variants, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("EUR" = "#08306B", "AFR" = "#67000D")) +
    labs(
      x = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      y = "Average Number of Credible Sets per Locus",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants",
      fill = "Population"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  return(p)
}

```
# 5) Call Credible Set Size Plotting Function ====
```{r}
create_faceted_barplot(input_df)
```
